name: codex-essentials
description: Repository maintenance tooling for the Codex Essentials plugin marketplace.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run marketplace:check && npm run marketplace:test && npm run github-labels:test && npm run validate:github-labels && npm run ruff:format:check && npm run ruff:check && npm run basedpyright:check && npm run shfmt:check && npm run shellcheck:check && npm run actionlint:check
scripts.ruff:check: ruff check --force-exclude -- scripts/generate_marketplace.py scripts/test_generate_marketplace.py scripts/validate_github_labels.py scripts/test_validate_github_labels.py
scripts.ruff:format:check: ruff format --check --force-exclude -- scripts/generate_marketplace.py scripts/test_generate_marketplace.py scripts/validate_github_labels.py scripts/test_validate_github_labels.py
